generation.scope: Point modules in every finite four-vertex cut are Serre-fixed up to shift three. Their mutual Ext dimensions are the mixed opposite rank defect, symmetric and independent of phase. For twenty reduced points with full middle supports the singularity incidences of the Lagrange cubics give the same undirected graph of valency at most four in each embedding. The general mixed component has twenty mutually orthogonal three-spherical modules with faithful direct sum.

open_mathematics: Determine whether point-ideal generators or their conormal modules detect the remaining nonregular finite stable cuts. Analyze the rank-nineteen defect and fully asymmetric finite coordinate products and their relations.
